title: Synchronize tool call IDs, subagent IDs, enforce parent agent wait barrier, and harden SQLite dialog retrieval
author: tauri-rust-engineer
summary: Synchronized LLM tool call ID (tc.id) directly with in-process subagent IDs. Added toolCallId to subagent:spawned Tauri event. Hardened load_subagent_dialog and db::load_dialog_items to query by both subagent_id, tool_call_id, and prefix/suffix patterns. Enforced the parent agent wait barrier: synchronous oneshot 'subagent' tool blocks cleanly until completion, and compile_primed_system_prompt explicitly mandates awaiting subagent results.
